summary: UMC filed a Form 6-K containing two Taiwan Exchange announcements: an October 1, 2026 disclosure of machinery and equipment purchases from Applied Materials South East Asia Pte. Ltd. totaling NT$6,983,784,720 across 2025/12/23-2026/10/01, on a non-related-party, price-negotiation basis for production and R&D, plus September revenue. No board resolution, appraisal, CPA, or advisor was required. This is an ordinary capex procurement disclosure, not a corporate special situation; no stake, premium, or deal terms exist. Watch only revenue trajectory and capex cadence.
